Name: Lunch Pail
Author: tbonehunter
Description:
When you're on a deep mine run, having to stop, pull food out of inventory and go through the prompts to eat is disruptive. Lunch Pail allows you to craft a lunch pail, so at start of day you can stock your food supply into it, select which foods you want to replenish stamina, which to replenish health, and head to the mines (or fishing, or farming...)  When one supply is depleted, the lunch pail will automatically draw from the other. Configurable in GMCM for the health/stamina level at which food will be consumed. For example, if you select a level of 10%, when your stamina reaches a level that is 10% below the restorative effect of the food in your stamina compartment, that food will be consumed and push your stamina back up to 10% below full. Configurable to consume lowest value food first, or highest, or random. Gives non-intrusive warnings when supplies are running low, and again when depleted. Requires 1 copper bar and 50 fiber to craft, recipe attained at mining level 1.

[b]Note:[/b] Some foods offer higher benefits than your actual health or stamina capacity. These should be used with care, as to get benefit from them, your health or stamina level would have to drop to empty. I've added a base level toggle in the latest version to prevent complete depletion, but remember that "auto consumption" doesn't mean you never have to think about what you're eating.

[b]Note:[/b] Lunch Pail is emptied every night, so you'll need to pack a lunch at the start of every day, even if there were leftovers the previous day. They are still in inventory, just not in your lunch pail until you pack it. This is by design, so you will pay attention to your daily food, and make it appropriate to your day's schedule. [b]ALSO: [/b]Other than the nightly tidying up, Lunch Pail does not remove food from your backpack UNTIL it is consumed. What shows in your lunch pail is the food in inventory that you have allocated to auto-consume when needed. It will still take up slots in your backpack just as it would if you were taking it with you for the day.

Version 1.2.0 adds "Base Level" toggle, so your health/stamina won't be depleted waiting to auto-consume food that offers higher benefits than you actually need (eg, iridium cheese with health benefit of 147 when your health capacity is 100). Also inverts Target Fill slider appearance to make it more intuitive. When configuring it in GMCM, read the hover tooltips  for detailed explanations of each option.

Downloads.Description: Create a lunch pail to organize and auto-consume food when health or stamina fall below the level that the food will replenish to full strength (or your configured level.)
